studies.title: FDA Approval of Minoxidil for Androgenetic Alopecia
studies.finding: 5% topical minoxidil significantly increases hair count vs placebo in male pattern baldness

studies.title: Microneedling with Minoxidil vs Minoxidil Alone in AGA
studies.finding: Microneedling (1.5mm) + minoxidil: 91.4 hairs/cm² gain vs minoxidil alone: 22.2 hairs/cm². 4.1× improvement. 82% of microneedling group had >50% improvement. Note: this study proved microneedling works but did not compare depths.

studies.title: Microneedling in AGA: Comparing Two Different Depths of Microneedles
studies.finding: 0.6mm outperformed 1.2mm for both hair count (p=.017) and thickness (p=.007) when combined with minoxidil. Shallower depth was significantly less painful with better patient compliance.

studies.title: Phase III: Topical Finasteride 0.25% vs Oral Finasteride for Male AGA
studies.source: Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology
studies.finding: Topical finasteride: +20.2 hairs, Oral finasteride: +21.1 hairs (comparable). Topical: 70% scalp DHT reduction with only 24-30% serum DHT reduction. Adverse events = no different from placebo.

studies.title: Redensyl Clinical Evaluation for Hair Growth
studies.finding: 46.7% growth rate enhancement by day 90, 80.8% thickness improvement by day 120, 64.9% hair fall reduction.

studies.title: Saw Palmetto for Androgenetic Alopecia: Meta-Analysis
studies.source: Journal of Alternative and Complementary Medicine
studies.finding: 60% of patients showed improvement with saw palmetto across 502 patients. Zero sexual side effects reported. ~30% serum DHT reduction.

studies.title: Effect of Pumpkin Seed Oil on Hair Growth in Men with AGA
studies.finding: 400mg pumpkin seed oil daily: 40% increase in hair count at 24 weeks vs 10% in placebo group.

studies.title: Rosemary Oil vs Minoxidil 2% for Androgenetic Alopecia
studies.finding: Rosemary oil increased hair count comparably to minoxidil 2% at 6 months. Less scalp itching than minoxidil.

studies.title: Long-term Efficacy and Safety of Finasteride 1mg in Male Pattern Hair Loss
studies.source: Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology
studies.finding: Finasteride 1mg: significant hair count increase vs placebo at 12 and 24 months. ~5% sexual side effects (vs ~3% placebo in meta-analysis of 15 RCTs).

studies.title: Nocebo Effect in Finasteride Use for Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia
studies.finding: Men TOLD about sexual side effects: 43.6% reported them. Men NOT TOLD: only 15.3%. Nocebo multiplier: 2.85×.

studies.title: Clinical Evaluation of Pea Sprout Extract (Anagain) on Hair Growth
studies.finding: Anagen:telogen ratio improved from 4.0 to 7.2 (78% increase). 85% noticed regrowth after 3 months.

studies.title: Ketoconazole as Adjunct to Finasteride in Male AGA
studies.finding: 2% ketoconazole shampoo used 2-4×/week showed hair density improvement and anti-androgenic activity at the scalp.

studies.title: Low-Dose Oral Minoxidil Initiation: International Modified Delphi Consensus
studies.finding: Consensus on 76 prescribing items. Starting dose: 2.5mg/day for males. Effective for AGA with favorable safety profile at low doses.

studies.title: Effectiveness of Platelet-Rich Plasma in Treatment of Androgenic Alopecia: Meta-Analysis
studies.finding: PRP monotherapy significantly increased hair density vs control. Effective and safe at 3 and 6 months.

studies.title: Regenerative and Protective Actions of the GHK-Cu Peptide in Light of New Gene Data
studies.finding: GHK-Cu modulates genes for hair follicle development, increases follicle size, and stimulates growth via angiogenesis and anti-inflammatory pathways.

studies.title: Comparative Effectiveness of LLLT for Androgenic Alopecia: Meta-Analysis of RCTs
studies.finding: LLLT significantly increased hair density in both male and female patients with androgenetic alopecia vs sham devices.

studies.title: Baicapil Clinical Evaluation on Hair Growth and Density
studies.finding: Baicapil (soy + wheat sprout + Scutellaria) increased hair density by 52% and reduced hair loss by 34% at 3 months in a 60-patient study.

studies.title: Effect of Caffeine and Testosterone on Proliferation of Human Hair Follicles In Vitro
studies.finding: Caffeine (0.001-0.005%) counteracted testosterone-induced hair growth suppression and stimulated follicle elongation in organ culture.

studies.title: 3,3'-Diindolylmethane Modulates Estrogen Metabolism in Patients with Thyroid Disease
studies.finding: DIM shifted estrogen metabolism toward favorable 2-hydroxyestrone pathway. Supports hormonal balance relevant to DHT-sensitive tissues.

studies.title: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study Examining Effects of Ashwagandha on Hormones
studies.finding: Ashwagandha supplementation increased testosterone by 14.7% and DHEA-S by 18.2% vs placebo over 8 weeks. Also reduced cortisol.
